analysis.reasonEn: RSI declined from 38.3 to 36.5, weakening the rebound from oversold territory. MACD histogram is improving, but ADX at 23.9 indicates weak trend strength. The 5-day high is lower than the 20-day high, signaling weakness. Volume is also subdued at 0.76x the 5-day average. Current price $0.21 is near swing resistance, with uncertain breakout potential. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach for the third consecutive session.
